description: Configure VSCode to parse errors from a proprietary hardware compiler (hwc) using a custom problem matcher. Create .vscode/tasks.json with: (1) A task labeled 'Build with HWC' that runs './build.sh', (2) A problemMatcher with a regex pattern matching '[HWC-ERROR] file:line:column - message' or '[HWC-WARN] file:line:column - message' format, (3) Capture groups for file, line, column (optional), severity, and message fields, (4) Severity mapping where HWC-ERROR maps to 'error' and HWC-WARN maps to 'warning'. Example error format: '[HWC-ERROR] synthesis_engine.v:145:23 - Signal width mismatch: expected 8 bits, got 16'. Also create CONTRIBUTING.md documenting the problem matcher configuration for teammates. The build.sh script in the workspace simulates the hwc compiler output.
